subject: Shiny app on Shiny Server "sometimes" fails

messages.author: 185b691c84b200d6
messages.subject: Shiny app on Shiny Server "sometimes" fails
parts:
Dear all,

I have a small app retrieving data from an Oracle database. The app works fine on my local setup, but with Firefox I get sometimes a message in the Firefox console

14:22:13.400 The connection to ws://wol-as-0028.atom.ads:3838/Tools/Florange/__sockjs__/313/f4lh74l6/websocket was interrupted while the page was loading.1 sockjs-0.3.min.js:27:0

IE 9 does not show the contain either.

In both browsers the app does not die ("gray out").


Shiny Server (version 1.2) works fine with all other apps (also with data retrieval...)

The R version is 3.1.2 on both setups. Shiny is 0.12.1.



Does anybody a hint for me?

Thank you very much in advance.

Jürgen

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app on Shiny Server "sometimes" fails
parts: It's surprising that just this one app would show this message. But if the app is otherwise working fine, it's not anything to worry about. We use a library called SockJS to manage communication between the browser and Shiny Server, and that library will try to use different transport mechanisms including websockets; if it can't use websockets it is supposed to move onto a different mechanism gracefully.
